actions.condition: Before commercialization, redistribution or external AI/LLM egress of provider-derived evidence.
actions.action: Bind provider-specific evidence that explicitly approves each intended commercial-use, redistribution and AI-use right. Do not infer permission from a working key, public endpoint or current technical availability.
actions.verification: provider_data_rights.go remains fail closed until provider-specific evidence is bound; G7/G10/G15 evidence records the disposition.

actions.condition: When producing or deploying the hosted runtime.
actions.action: Build the hosted binary with -tags postgres, set DEPULSE_PERSISTENCE_BACKEND=postgres, provide DEPULSE_DATABASE_URL through the deployment secret store, and configure hosted origin/proxy values for the actual topology.
actions.verification: Hosted artifact/runtime audit proves PostgreSQL backend selection and health without exposing the connection string.

actions.condition: When live primary U.S. equity capability is enabled rather than demo/degraded fallback operation.
actions.action: Configure valid Finnhub and Alpaca credentials in secret storage and verify operational entitlement/health. Do not change Market Mode based on provider count.
actions.verification: Provider capability registry reports truthful operational state while Smart Provider Router remains the sole routing owner.

actions.condition: When optional AI research generation is enabled.
actions.action: Configure the credential for the selected AI provider. This satisfies only model API access; provider-derived source evidence still requires explicit AI-use rights before external egress.
actions.verification: Selected model provider is operational and the separate rights-aware AI-egress gate allows only evidence with approved AI-use rights.
